item.text:
`npm start` printed “listening” and then exited because [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.bDIdlP/shop-api/src/server.js) never opened a server socket. I added an HTTP listener and a `/health` endpoint. I also changed the startup error so it does not print configuration values.

Verified that `npm start` stays running, `/health` returns 200, and an unknown route returns 404.
